answers.core: Yes. It is a standard feature in other game engines, requires deep integration with the physics and rendering systems for performance, and is a foundational need for professional-quality visual effects in any 3D game.
answers.workaround: No. Workarounds are extremely inefficient (manual raycasting), impractical for complex geometry, or require advanced custom scripting. This is a fundamental system that needs to be built into the engine for performance and accessibility.
